verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              प्रदोषार्द्धे कदाचित्तु कृष्णे रतिपरयणे। त्रासयन्त्समदो गोष्ठमरिष्टः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥१॥
verses.english: Entering a battlefield or launching of missiles is prohibited during the period of अशौच - ceremonially unclean state - this is the dictum of the past-masters...
verses.bhavadeepa: चक्रवालैः मण्डलैः हल्लीसकक्रीडनम् एकस्य पुंसो बहुभिः स्त्रीभिः क्रीडनं सैव रासक्रीडा। "गोपीनां मण्डलीनृत्यबन्धने हल्लीसकं विदुः”। इति कोशात् तल्लक्षणं तु- "पृथुं सुवृत्तं मसृणं वितस्तिमात्रोन्नतं कौ विनिखन्य शङ्कुम्। आक्रम्य पद्भ्यामितरेतरं तु हस्तैर्भ्रमोऽयं खलु रासगोष्ठी"॥३५॥

verses.sanskrit: निर्वाणाङ्गारमेघाभस्तीक्ष्णशृङ्गोऽर्कलोचनः। क्षुरतीक्ष्णाग्रचरणः कालः काल इवापरः॥२॥
verses.english: Even in this birth as swans those seven brothers, who are basically the adherent of brahma-theory, have conducted themselves in a similar method, i.e., following yogic practises etc, always reminiscing past events while moving there about at Lake मानस...
verses.bhavadeepa: अथैकविंशे ह्यध्याये अरिष्टं वृषरूपिणम्। देवशत्रुं दुराधर्षं कृष्णोऽहनदितीर्यते॥१॥ प्रदोषार्द्ध इति॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: लेलिहानः सनिष्पेषं जिह्वयोष्ठौ पुनः पुनः। गर्विताविद्धलाङ्गूलः कठिनस्कन्धबन्धनः॥३॥
verses.english: They are known by these namnes in this birth as swans: सुमन, शुचि-वाक्, शुद्ध, पञ्चम, cछिद्र-दर्शन, सु-नेत्र, स्वतन्त्र...
verses.bhavadeepa: निर्वाणाङ्गारः इङ्गालः मेघश्च तदुभयाभः कालः कृष्णवर्णः कालायिता संहर्ता वेत्यर्थः॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: ककुदोदग्रनिर्माणः प्रमाणाद्दुरतिक्रमः। शकृन्मूत्रोपलिप्ताङ्गो गवामुद्वेजनो भृशम्॥४॥
verses.english: These seven-brAhmaNa-s who strictly conducted themselves under their vows have taken birth as the sons of kaushika, namely vishvamitra, but they have become the disciples of sage gArgya when their father, namely vishvamitra, cursed them...
verses.bhavadeepa: गर्वितं दर्पः तेन आविद्धं भ्रामितं लाङ्गूलं येन सः कठिनं स्कन्धबन्धनं ककुद्यस्य॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: महाकटिः स्थूलमुखो दृढजानुर्महोदरः। विषाणावल्गितगतिर्लम्बता कण्ठचर्मणा॥५॥
verses.english: On certain day those seven-brAhmaNa disciples have taken कपिल named milking cow of their guru gArgya along with its calf to nearby woods for grazing according to their routine... but on their way back they have become awfully hungry, whereby a cruel thought occurred to some them to use up that cow as their viand in all their stupidity and heedlessness, for which they have become lawbreakers...
verses.bhavadeepa: ककुदेति। ककुदाघातेन उदग्रम् अग्रनिहितं कृतं निर्माणं महाप्रासादादिरचनं येन स तथा। ककुदाघातेन ताडिते वृक्षप्रासादमूले सर्वमपि तद्भज्यत इत्यर्थः॥४॥

verses.sanskrit: गवारोहेषु चपलस्तरुघाताङ्किताननः। युद्धसज्जविषाणाग्रो द्विषद्वृषभसूदनः॥६॥
verses.english: These seven-brAhmaNa-s who strictly conducted themselves under their vows have taken birth as the sons of kaushika, namely vishvamitra, but they have become the disciples of sage gArgya when their father, namely vishvamitra, cursed them...

verses.sanskrit: अरिष्टो नाम हि गवामरिष्टो दारुणाकृतिः। दैत्यो वृषभरूपेण गोष्ठान्विपरिधावति॥७॥
verses.english: Yet another one from them, named पितृवर्ति, who is a thoroughgoing beatifier and ritualist, spoke angrily to all of them, himself abiding by his tenets, “if it is absolutely necessary to butcher the cow, butcher it collectively, in the name of manes.... when this cow is righteously offered to manes no unrighteousness can touch us and, besides, this cow which by its own nature is a sacrificial animal, she too will meet its end as a sacrificial cow... no doubt about it...”

verses.sanskrit: पातयानो गवां गर्भान्दृप्तो गच्छत्यनार्तवम्। जृम्भमाणश्च चपलो गृष्टीः सम्प्रचचार ह॥८॥
verses.english: Saying ‘so be it...’ all of them have sublimated and immolated that cow as an offertory to manes, and devoured the leavings satisfying their hunger...

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गप्रहरणो रौद्रः प्रहरन्गोषु दुर्मदः। गोष्ठेषु न रतिं लेभे विना युद्धेन गोवृषः॥९॥
verses.english: However, two from them, named कवि and ख-सृम, entreatingly tried their best to prevent others from butchering the cow... but those two could not succeed in their effort...
verses.bhavadeepa: गृष्टीः सद्यः प्रसूताः गाः सम्प्रचचार जगाम। रेतःसेकायेत्यर्थः॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य स वृषः केशवाग्रतः। आजगाम बलोदग्रो वैवस्वतवशे स्थितः॥१०॥
verses.english: Sage gArgya took the calf believing their lie unsuspectingly... those seven disciples departed from this world when their mortality is lessened, but carrying the blot of unjustly deceiving their teacher with them...

verses.sanskrit: स तत्र गास्तु प्रसभं बाधमानो मदोत्कटः। चकार निर्वृषं गोष्ठं निर्वत्सशिशुपुङ्गवम्॥११॥
verses.english: Because they have undertaken a cruel act like savages in respect of teacher’s cow, they took rebirth as seven mighty and hearty sons of a huntsman...

verses.sanskrit: एतस्मिन्नेव कले तु गावः कृष्णसमीपगाः। त्रासयामास दुष्टात्मा वैवस्वतवशे स्थितः॥१२॥
verses.english: Because they scripturally worshipped manes and firstly offered the cow to manes before their using it up, they retained the reminiscence about their last births in the present birth as hunters... thus those seven took birth as judicious huntsmen in दशार्ण province...

verses.sanskrit: सेन्द्राशनिरिवाम्भोदो नर्दमानो महासुरः। तालशब्देन तं कृष्णस्सिंहनादैश्च मोहयन्॥१३॥
verses.english: Those seven huntsmen brothers are always engrossed in their activity discarding greed and falsification... they used to hunt only that much that is useful for sustenance, and used to pull through rest of the time in contemplation... these are the names of those highly righteous hunters: निर्-वैर, निर्-वृति, शान्त, निर्-मन्यु, कृति, वैधस, मातृ-वर्ति॥।

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यधावत गोविन्दो दैत्यं वृषभरूपिणम्। स कृष्णं गोवृषो दृष्ट्वा हृष्टलाङ्गूललोचनः॥१४॥
verses.english: One from these seven brothers who happened to be the fifth son of kaushika, named as कवि,now takes rebirth as पान्चिक; while thesixth son of कौशिक named ख-सृमtakes birth as कण्डरीक; further, the seventh son of kaushika named पितृ-वर्त्i will take rebirth as ब्रह्म-दत्त...

verses.sanskrit: रोषितस्तालशब्देन युद्धाकाङ्क्षी ननर्द ह। तमापतन्तं दुर्वृत्तं दृष्ट्वा वृषभरूपिणम्। तस्मात्स्थानान्न व्यचलत्कृष्णो गिरिरिवाचलः॥१५॥
verses.english: Sage gArgya took the calf believing their lie unsuspectingly... those seven disciples departed from this world when their mortality is lessened, but carrying the blot of unjustly deceiving their teacher with them...
verses.bhavadeepa: हृष्टम् उत्फलितं लाङ्गूलं लोचने च येन सः॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: स कुक्षौ वृषभो दृष्टिं प्रणिधाय धृताननः। कृष्णस्य निधनाकाङ्क्षी तूर्णमभ्युत्पपात ह॥१६॥
verses.english: These seven wild animals have seven names as: उन्मुख, नित्य-वित्रस्त, स्तब्ध-कर्ण, विलोचन, पण्डित, घस्मर, नादि॥।

verses.sanskrit: तमापतन्तं प्रमुखे प्रतिजग्राह दुर्द्धरम्। कृष्णः कृष्णाञ्जननिभो वृषं प्रतिवृषोपमः॥१७॥
verses.english: They used to mill about on that mountain always reminiscing on their futurity, because they are endowed with knowledge of earlier births, duly observing forbearance, non-duality, placability, and equilibrating all pairs of opposites like hunger-hunting, animosity-friendliness etc; finally, reaching a dry land they took up asceticism sustaining themselves on meagre diet and water - as a kind of जल-त्याग-व्रत, discarding water as a vow; and breathed their last... even today the footprints of those seven animals can be seen on that mountain कालन्जर, where they undertook asceticism without water and food... this marks the end of their rebirth as animals...

verses.sanskrit: स संसक्तस्तु कृष्णो वै वृषेणेव महावृषः। मुमोच वक्त्रजं फेनं नस्तश्चाथ सशब्दवत्॥१८॥
verses.english: Then they have attained rebirth as चक्रवाक birds just by the dint of their pietistic behaviour even when they are wild animals, without a trace of unholiness...
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रमुखे मुखाग्रे ओष्ठयोरित्यर्थः। वेगेन इति वा पाठः॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: तावन्योन्यावरुद्धाङ्गौ युद्धे कृष्णवृषावुभौ। रेजतुर्मेघसमये संसक्ताविव तोयदौ॥१९॥
verses.english: Those seven water dwelling waterfowls, चार्वाक birds, lived on a beautiful island like saints, duly leaving off pairing and mating... now, these seven have names like this: निःस्पृह, निर्-मम, क्षान्त, निर्-द्वन्द्व, निष्-परिग्रह, निर्वृत्ति, निभृत॥। even as birds they have undertaken asceticism forgoing sustenance, later they discarded lives as birds on the banks of a lake...

verses.sanskrit: तस्य दर्पबलं हत्वा कृत्वा शृङ्गान्तरे पदम्। आपीडयदरिष्टस्य कण्ठं क्लिन्नमिवाम्बरम्॥२०॥
verses.english: Later, those seven brothers took birth as royal swans residing about Lake मानस, and they continued to live a celibate life because they have drawn memories of past life into this present life as swans...

verses.sanskrit: शृङ्गं चास्य पुनः सव्यमुत्पाट्य यमदण्डावत्। तेनैव प्राहरद्वक्त्रे स ममार भृशं हतः॥२१॥
verses.english: Those seven huntsmen brothers are always engrossed in their activity discarding greed and falsification... they used to hunt only that much that is useful for sustenance, and used to pull through rest of the time in contemplation... these are the names of those highly righteous hunters: निर्-वैर, निर्-वृति, शान्त, निर्-मन्यु, कृति, वैधस, मातृ-वर्ति॥।

verses.sanskrit: स भिन्नशृङ्गो भग्नास्यो भग्नस्कन्धश्च दानवः। पपात रुधिरोद्गारी साम्बुधार इवाम्बुदः॥२२॥
verses.english: They are known by these namnes in this birth as swans: सुमन, शुचि-वाक्, शुद्ध, पञ्चम, cछिद्र-दर्शन, सु-नेत्र, स्वतन्त्र...

verses.sanskrit: गोविन्देन हतं दृष्ट्वा दृप्तं वृषभदानवम्। साधु साध्विति भूतानि तत्कर्मास्याभितुष्टुवुः॥२३॥
verses.english: One from these seven brothers who happened to be the fifth son of kaushika, named as कवि,now takes rebirth as पान्चिक; while thesixth son of कौशिक named ख-सृमtakes birth as कण्डरीक; further, the seventh son of kaushika named पितृ-वर्त्i will take rebirth as ब्रह्म-दत्त...

verses.sanskrit: स चोपेन्द्रो वृषं हत्वा कान्तचन्द्रे निशामुखे। अरविन्दाभनयनः पुनरेव ररास ह॥२४॥
तेऽपि गोवृत्तयः सर्वे कृष्णं कमललोचनम्। उपासाञ्चक्रिरे हृष्टाः सर्वे शक्रमिवामराः॥२५॥
verses.english: These seven wild animals have seven names as: उन्मुख, नित्य-वित्रस्त, स्तब्ध-कर्ण, विलोचन, पण्डित, घस्मर, नादि॥।
